claims.content: Customer
The Customer has added at least one item to their Shopping Cart.
The Customer is logged into their registered user account.
The Customer has a valid, active credit card or PayPal account linked to their profile for payment processing.
The auction for the item(s) in the cart has ended, and the Customer is the winning bidder (or the item is a 'Buy It Now' purchase).
The Customer navigates to their Shopping Cart and clicks the 'Checkout' button.
The system displays the 'Review Your Order' page, summarizing the items, shipping address, and payment method.
The Customer reviews the order details and clicks the 'Place Your Order' button to finalize the transaction.
The system processes the payment via the linked credit card or PayPal account.
Upon successful payment authorization, the system generates an Order Confirmation page displaying the Order ID and summary.
The system sends an automated email confirmation to the Customer containing the order details and receipt.
The system updates the inventory status for the purchased items and notifies the seller (if applicable) to prepare for shipment.

If the Customer's payment method (credit card or PayPal) is declined or invalid during processing, the system displays an error message on the 'Review Your Order' page prompting the Customer to update their payment information or select a different method.

If the Customer attempts to checkout with an item that is no longer available (e.g., inventory discrepancy), the system redirects them to the Shopping Cart with a notification that the item has been removed.

If the Customer chooses to pay via 'Bill Me Later' (invoice option) instead of immediate credit card/PayPal processing, the system generates an invoice and skips the immediate payment authorization step, proceeding directly to Order Confirmation.
The Customer's payment method is successfully charged or an invoice is generated.
A new Order record is created in the system with a unique Order ID and 'Paid' (or 'Invoiced') status.
The inventory count for the purchased item(s) is decremented.
The Seller is notified of the sale and provided with shipping details.
An email confirmation containing the receipt and order summary is sent to the Customer.
